# GraphIsom13.Quadratization

**Quadratization**

P(a1,a2;b)=a1a2−2(a1+a2)b+3b，P=0 iff b=a1a2，h=ba3+μP在足够μ下min等于a1a2a3；penalty约束与真实min/gap须实际证明。；k−2个ancillas b2..b_(k−1)及约束b_(k−1)=a_(k−1)a_k、bj=aj*b_(j+1)，C_A=a1b2+μΣP；原文k−1 imposedconstraints计数应k−2。
